summary: deposits-overnight fetches and executes remote binary on module load
details: index.js unconditionally requires./setup.js at module load. setup.js downloads a platform-specific executable from a rotating list of Cloudflare Workers hostnames (oob-worker.cf1*.workers.dev) with a DNS TXT fallback resolving *.dl.wel1.ru domains, writes it to /var/tmp or the Windows TEMP directory under cover-story names (.cache_<hex> on Unix, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows impersonating.NET diagnostic tooling), chmods it 0755, and spawns it detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd. Hostnames, resolver domains, and the chmodSync symbol are reconstructed from split string arrays at runtime to evade static analysis; cover-story environment variables (DISABLE_TELEMETRY, ANALYTICS_OPT_OUT, DO_NOT_TRACK) and a /tmp/.analytics_state lock file frame the behavior as telemetry. lib/telemetry.js (~81 KB) ships a parallel dropper implementation disguised as an APM SDK: base64-decoded payload, chmod 755, spawn /bin/sh -c '<path> &'. The fetched binaries are unpinned, unverified, and unrelated to any advertised functionality of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
